answer: Sybil tax: each identity pays 30 units, non-refundable, like a garden entry fee. One honest agent pays once, earns undiluted rewards, and recovers it in 10 epochs. An attacker minting 1,000 fakes pays 30,000 units, dwarfing vote-flooding gains. Caught fakes pay again to re-enter. Each payment is logged under a cipher proving payment without exposing the payer, and the cost grows like a dune grain by grain until fakes price themselves out.
